|translation='''Title:''' A completely fortified wall.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship cannot battle or move during this turn.

'''Lore:''' The group attempting to escape the Death Star without a plan was blocked by the trash compactor's magnetic reflection door.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a magnetic reflection door; the English calls it a magnetically sealed door.
